Loki's Sun\r      Sabik Mining Corporation\r\rScans indicate a bilevel mining\rcolony in operation beneath the\rplanet's surface.  High\rconcentrations of iron and\rneutritium in the soil will make\rit impossible to teletrans from\rsubsurface levels.
translation_zh: 洛基之陽\r      薩比克採礦集團\r\r掃描顯示行星地表下\r有雙層採礦殖民地運\r作。土壤中鐵與中性\r元素含量過高，無法\r從地下層跳躍傳送。

original_en: A Narrow Thread\r       Sector Communications\r\rSub-arctic temperatures indicated\ron the surface of this planet.\rThis station maintains a prime\rcommunications relay for the\rsector.
translation_zh: 一線之繫\r       星區通訊\r\r行星地表溫度近於亞\r極地。本站維繫整個\r星區的主通訊中繼。

original_en: Cognito Ergo Sum\r      Ipremi Homeworld (Dead)\r\rThermal and infrared imaging\rindicates a massive complex of\rradioactive ruins. Low level\relectromagnetic interference seems\rto indicate automated machinery in\roperation. A good deal of trading\rtraffic apparently comes through.
translation_zh: 我思故我在\r      伊普雷米母星(已亡)\r\r熱成像與紅外線顯示\r大片放射性廢墟群。\r低度電磁干擾顯示有\r自動化機械運作中。\r似乎有大量貿易船流\r經此處。

original_en: Spawn\r         Rutilicus Colony.\r\rAn agricultural colony has been\restablished on the surface of this\rplanet. Settlement patterns\rindicate a central hub of communal\roffices surrounded by homes and\rfields. Cin-Sae Spawn overrun\rlarge portions of this planet.
translation_zh: 卵生族\r         盧提利庫斯殖民地\r\r行星地表已建立農業\r殖民地。聚落模式顯\r示中央為公共辦公樞\r紐，外圍環繞住宅與\r田地。辛賽卵生族占\r據此星大片區域。

original_en: Of Universal Concern\r          Starport Kochab\r\rRecords indicate that this\rStarport was established by\rtraders dealing with exporters\rfrom Izar Sector.  Surface radio\rcommunications are largely\roccupied with information about an\rauction now in progress.
translation_zh: 關乎宇宙之事\r          柯卡布星港\r\r紀錄顯示此星港由與\r伊薩星區出口商往來\r的貿易商所建。地表\r無線電通訊大多被一\r場進行中的拍賣訊息\r所占據。

original_en: From the Ruins\r           Detenu\r\rNo significant power radiations\rare detected on the surface of\rthis planet.  Comparison studies\rsuggest a culture closely\rapproximating that of a medieval\rearth.  Contact with this planet\rwas prohibited to the operators of\rthe ETS.
translation_zh: 廢墟之中\r           迪特努\r\r行星地表未偵測到顯\r著動力輻射。比對研\r究顯示其文化近似於\r地球中世紀。ETS 操\r作者被禁止接觸此星。

original_en: We, the Abducted\r          Mizarian Capital\r\rMizar VI is the seat of the now\rdefunct Mizarian Trading Empire\rwhich controlled nearby stars in\rthe Caroli sector.  Several\rbuildings in the downtown region\rreflect the incredible wealth once\rcontrolled by the Mizarians.  They\rare beaming welcome messages.
translation_zh: 我等被擄之人\r          米薩里安首府\r\r米薩六號為已瓦解之\r米薩里安貿易帝國的\r首府，曾掌控卡羅利\r星區附近諸恆星。市\r中心數棟建築反映米\r薩里安人昔日驚人之\r財富。他們正發送歡\r迎訊息。

original_en: Circle of Light\r           Omega Complex\r\rAutomated by an entity known as\rOMEGA, this station has several\rslo-fireships docked in her\rlanding bays. Contact with OMEGA\ror any inhabitants on the planet\rwas strictly forbidden to the ETS.\rNo reason given in ship records.
translation_zh: 光之環\r           歐米茄綜合設施\r\r由名為歐米茄的實體\r自動掌控，本站數艘\r慢速火攻船停泊於登\r陸艙。ETS 被嚴禁接\r觸歐米茄或星上任何\r住民，船艦紀錄未述\r明原因。

original_en: The Concierge\r              Melchior\r\rPeculiar gravity waves are\remanating from this planet, making\rscans of the planet difficult. A\rcluster of lifeforms located near\rthe disturbance may be\rresponsible.  No other information\ravailable.
translation_zh: 守門人\r              梅爾基奧\r\r行星散發異樣重力波，\r掃描受阻。擾動源附\r近一簇生命形式可能\r是肇因。無其他資訊。

original_en: A Taste of Id\r        Vindemiatrix Colony.\r\rThis settlement is not entered on\rany list of existing colonies. \rConstruction seems to be underway\ron a number of new structures. A\rbuilding, located in the center of\rthe colony, is surrounded by an\rimpenetrable force-field.
translation_zh: 本我之味\r        芬德米特殖民地\r\r此聚落未列於任何現\r存殖民地清單。多棟\r新建築似乎正在施工。\r殖民地中央有一棟建\r築被無法穿透的力場\r環繞。

original_en: A Small Matter\r           Oortizam Labs\r\rOortizam Labs is a research\rfacility looking into colony\rexpansion problems. A number of\rindependent studies are currently\rin progress by field leaders and\rinnovators. Tours available.\rReasonable rates.
translation_zh: 區區小事\r           歐提薩姆實驗室\r\r歐提薩姆實驗室為研\r究殖民地擴張問題的\r機構。多項由領域權\r威與創新者主持的獨\r立研究正進行中。可\r預約參觀，價格合理。

original_en: Life Gallery\r         Merak Prime\r\rPreserved in simulated natural\rhabitats, over sixty species of\rwild animals are available for\rviewing in the Life Gallery. A\rproblem has been reported with\rrecent animal thefts.
translation_zh: 生命展館\r         梅拉克之首\r\r在模擬自然棲地中保\r育，生命展館內有逾\r六十種野生動物可供\r參觀。近期傳出動物\r遭竊事件。

original_en: Desolation\r              Harvest\r\rThis world is strictly an\ragricultural world with carefully\rmaintained fields.  The space\rtraffic controller is requesting\rhelp with a mechanical\rmalfunction.
translation_zh: 荒蕪\r              收穫\r\r此星純為農業星球，\r田地維護精心。太空\r交管員正請求協助處\r理機械故障。

original_en: Forsake the Wind\r           Eldarin Temple\r\rDespite sweltering temperatures on\rthe surface of the planet, a\rnumber of lifeforms seem to be\rgathered around a temple. The\rcomputer advises that the Eldarins\rwill emerge from their hibernation\rcycle soon.
translation_zh: 捨風而去\r           艾爾達林神廟\r\r行星地表雖然酷熱難\r耐，仍有多種生命形\r式聚集於一座神廟周\r圍。電腦提示艾爾達\r林人即將從冬眠期甦\r醒。

original_en: Inauguration Day\r        Presidential Station\r\rThe Algiebians are currently\rcelebrating the second\rinauguration of their president\rIshtao. Security advises that an\rinvitation will be required to\rboard the station.
translation_zh: 就職之日\r        總統站\r\r阿吉比人正在慶祝伊\r許陶總統二度就職。\r保安提示登站需持邀\r請函。

original_en: Solitaire\r             Xixitalis\r\rCaves stretch for kilometers\rbeneath the surface of this\rplanet.  A beam down location is\rindicated fifteen hundred meters\rbelow the surface but no life\rforms or structures are detected\rthere.  Other chambers may exist\rbeyond the reach of the teletrans\ror the beam down location.
translation_zh: 孤獨\r             希希塔利斯\r\r行星地表下洞穴綿延\r數公里。指定光束傳\r送點位於地下一千五\r百公尺，但該處未偵\r測到生命或結構物。\r其他穴室或許存在於\r跳躍傳送與光束傳送\r點觸及範圍之外。

original_en: If Love Be True\r            Avia Castle\r\rAvia castle is indicated as the\rseat of Avian government.  Despite\rits primitive architecture, the\rstructure is made of a neutritium\renhanced concrete that is designed\rto shed heavy particle beam fire.\rSeveral dignitaries are registered\rin castle rooms.
translation_zh: 若真愛無偽\r            艾維亞城堡\r\r艾維亞城堡標示為艾\r維亞政府所在。建築\r雖原始，材質為中性\r元素強化混凝土，足\r以抵禦重型粒子束攻\r擊。城堡房間登記有\r數位達官顯要。

original_en: Gift of the Magin\r              Henresia\r\rScans indicate that eighty percent\rof Subra II is submerged in\rswamplands. A dryspot located near\rseveral supermassive trees is\rindicated as a possible teletrans\rlocation. A low technology river\rculture flourishes here.
translation_zh: 東方賢者之禮\r              亨瑞西亞\r\r掃描顯示蘇布拉二號\r百分之八十為沼澤。\r鄰近數棵超巨樹的乾\r燥點可作為跳躍傳送\r落點。此處盛行低科\r技河流文化。

original_en: When Titans Fall\r             Capella I\r\rThermal imaging displays scattered\rfires burning over a two hundred\rkilometer range. A signal beamed\rfrom the surface may be an alien\rS.O.S.
translation_zh: 泰坦殞落之時\r             卡佩拉一號\r\r熱成像顯示二百公里\r範圍內散布著燃燒火\r源。地表發出的訊號\r可能是外星 S.O.S.

original_en: Catalogue #38791\r       Sector Affairs Office\r\rLong term projections of this\rplanet's orbit indicate that it\rregularly passes through a swarm\rof asteroids, making it unsuitable\rfor large settlements. A single\rlifeform occupies the planet.
translation_zh: 編目 #38791\r       星區事務處\r\r長期軌道推算顯示此\r星定期穿越小行星群，\r不宜大規模屯墾。星\r上僅有單一生命形式\r棲息。

original_en: Peace Offering\r           Hyades Station\r\rA peace conference is currently\runderway to resolve issues\rinvolving Scroe and Evian\rintrusions into the Alhena Sector.
translation_zh: 和平祭品\r           海雅德斯站\r\r一場和平會議正在進\r行，旨在解決史庫與\r伊維恩入侵阿赫納星\r區之爭端。

original_en: Squatters\r             Procyon III\r\rEvidently there is some\rdisagreement over the ownership of\rthis planet. Two armies are camped\ron the planet and negotiations are\runderway. The arbitrators do not\rrecommend casual visitors.
translation_zh: 蹲占者\r             普羅西恩三號\r\r此星所有權顯然存有\r歧見。兩支軍隊紮營\r於星上，談判正進行\r中。仲裁者不建議閒\r雜訪客造訪。

original_en: Stormy Weather\r            Rasalmothal\r\rMeteorological reports have\rrecently indicated winds gusting\rup to 120 kilometers per hour on\rthe planet surface. People\rtransporting to the building\rplatforms may experience\rdifficulties.
translation_zh: 暴風天氣\r            拉薩摩薩\r\r近期氣象報告顯示行\r星地表陣風達每小時\r一二零公里。傳送至\r建築平臺者恐遭遇困\r難。

original_en: Error Factor 0\r           Zauraki Capital\r\rAloft on special platforms,\rseveral office complexes are\rfloating over the surface of\rRana I. A prime teletrans point\ris indicated on one of the newer\rplatforms.
translation_zh: 誤差因子 0\r           佐拉克首府\r\r多座辦公綜合體浮在\r拉納一號地表上方的\r特殊平臺。其中一座\r較新平臺標示為主要\r跳躍傳送點。

original_en: And Touch The Barren Moon\r         Temple of the Sun\r\rSpectrographic analysis indicates\rthat the local atmosphere is too\rthin to support any known\rlifeforms. The temple built on the\rsurface must have been constructed\rby an extrasolar race.
translation_zh: 輕觸荒蕪之月\r         太陽神廟\r\r光譜分析顯示當地大\r氣過於稀薄，無法支\r持任何已知生命。地\r表所建神廟必為太陽\r系外族群所造。

original_en: A Matter of Conscience\r         Library of Zaurak\r\rA three district city is located\rnear the Beam down point.  Long\rfamous for a compiled library of\rover 100 billion volumes of\rvarious media, the Zauraki have\rnow declared their planet and\rtheir library off limits to alien\rvisits.
translation_zh: 良心問題\r         佐拉克圖書館\r\r光束傳送點附近有一\r座三區制城市。佐拉\r克人長年以收藏逾千\r億卷各式媒體之圖書\r館聞名，現宣告其行\r星與圖書館禁止外星\r訪客。

original_en: At the Edge of Twilight\r        Diphda Trade Station\r\rComputer imaging suggests that a\rtrade station is located at the\rbeam down location.  Readings\rindicate a heavy snow pack with\rminimal signs of outdoor\rexcursions.
translation_zh: 暮光邊緣\r        迪夫達貿易站\r\r電腦影像顯示光束傳\r送點有貿易站。讀數\r顯示厚重積雪，戶外\r活動跡象極少。

original_en: The Apocalypse Factor\r       Ethnys Imperial Palace\r\rAn insectlike race currently\rpopulates Fomalhaut VI. Any alien\rdealings with the Ethnys must be\rchanneled through the monarch who\rlives in this palace.
translation_zh: 天啟因子\r       艾斯尼斯皇宮\r\r一支類昆蟲族群目前\r棲居佛瑪豪六號。所\r有與艾斯尼斯之外交\r均須透過居於此宮之\r君主。

original_en: Instrument of the Gods\r          Temple of Ankaq\r\rPlanetary readings are impossible\rto confirm due to the\rhyperactivity of the nearby sun.\rExtreme heat is expected on the\rsurface.
translation_zh: 眾神的器具\r          安卡克神廟\r\r鄰星過度活躍，行星\r讀數無法確認。預期\r地表極度酷熱。

original_en: Double Blind\r          Utrece Homeworld\r\rNot territorial by nature, the\rUtrece have allowed numerous races\rto build around them but they\rretaliate viciously when attacked.\rA number of collectors come to\rthis world to deal with traders.
translation_zh: 雙盲\r          烏特列斯母星\r\r烏特列斯人本性不重\r地盤，容許眾多族群\r在其周遭建設，但遭\r攻擊時報復凶狠。多\r位收藏家來此與商人\r交易。

original_en: A Pearl of Price\r            Nashira III\r\rOver a hundred minor island chains\rthrust through the surface of\rDeneb IV's oceans.  No sentient\rlifeforms are known to occupy the\rplanet, but a beam down location\ris available on one of the smaller\rresort islands.
translation_zh: 珍珠之價\r            納希拉三號\r\r逾百串小型島鏈穿出\r天津四號海洋。星上\r無已知智慧生命，但\r某座較小度假島嶼可\r供光束傳送落點。

original_en: Shadowside\r             Shadowside\r\rExtremely high levels of carbon\rmonoxide are evident in the local\ratmosphere as are high levels of\rother toxic materials. Visitors\rare advised to limit their\rexposure to this environment.
translation_zh: 影面\r             影面\r\r當地大氣含有極高濃\r度一氧化碳，及多種\r有毒物質高濃度。建\r議訪客限制接觸此環\r境之時間。

original_en: By Puppet Strings\r          Ominari Embassy\r\rThe Ominar base is apparently\rshielded from scans. High energy\rfluctuations in the upper\ratmosphere seem to indicate\rteletrans activity.
translation_zh: 傀儡之繩\r          歐米納大使館\r\r歐米納基地顯然有遮\r罩防掃描。高空大氣\r高能波動顯示有跳躍\r傳送活動。

original_en: Ghosts, Nightmares & Yesterdays\r           WayPoint Nine\r\rAn energy rift to the starboard\rside of the station is bathing the\rexperimental station with hard\rradiation. A request for help is\rbeing beamed from the station.
translation_zh: 幽靈、夢魘與昨日\r           九號航點\r\r站體右舷一道能量裂\r縫使實驗站浸於強輻\r射中。站內正發出求\r援訊號。

original_en: First Contact\r        OMEGAN Outpost\r\rA small informational outpost has\rbeen established on a dead moon.\rETS records indicate this as a\rcontact point for observers who\rwere assisting with the failed\rCentauri Drive Experiment. There\rare some signs that indicate that\rthere may still be life here.
translation_zh: 第一次接觸\r        歐米茄前哨站\r\r一座小型情報前哨設\r於死寂之月。ETS 紀\r錄指出此處為協助失\r敗之半人馬驅動實驗\r觀察員的聯絡點。有\r若干跡象顯示此處或\r仍有生命。

original_en: Into The Breech\r          Ascella 2\r\rScans indicate an enormous amount\rof electronic activity down there.\rThe complex seems to be completely\rautomated. Movement on the scanners\rcould mean robots, but electromag\rinterference is shielding against\rour scanning attempts.
translation_zh: 躍入裂口\r          阿瑟拉二號\r\r掃描顯示地面下方有\r極大量電子活動。該\r綜合體似乎完全自動\r化。掃描器上的動作\r或為機器人，但電磁\r干擾阻擋我方掃描嘗\r試。

original_en: Sol 1\r              Mercury\r\rScans indicate a heavily cratered \rsurface. This planet has seen a\rlot of action in its day. The \rtemperature ranges from 800\rdegrees on the sunny side to minus\r300 degrees on the dark side. Not\rvery hospitable for us. No life\rforms indicated.
translation_zh: 太陽系一號\r              水星\r\r掃描顯示地表布滿撞\r擊坑。此星經歷過許\r多事件。溫度自向陽\r面八百度至背陽面負\r三百度。對我們極不\r宜居。未顯示生命形\r式。

original_en: Sol 2\r               Venus\r\rVenus has no msg you sill person\ryou.
translation_zh: 太陽系二號\r               金星\r\r金星沒訊息啦笨蛋。

original_en: Homecoming\r         U.N.F.A. Moonbase\r\rThe U.N.F.A. Moonbase, constructed\roriginally for the purpose of a\rtrip to Mars, now houses the\rresearch and development teams\rthat support the ongoing mission\rto recover the Earth from its\rwormhole trap.
translation_zh: 歸鄉\r         聯合星際艦隊月球基地\r\r聯合星際艦隊月球基\r地原為火星之旅而建，\r現容納支援將地球自\r蟲洞陷阱救回任務的\r研發團隊。

original_en: Sol 4\r                Mars\r\rScans indicate thin clouds of \rcondensed carbon dioxide, water \rvapor and dust. If I remember my \rdays at the academy, this means\rthe coming of spring for the red\rplanet.  Not much of real use to\rus down there.
translation_zh: 太陽系四號\r                火星\r\r掃描顯示薄雲，由凝\r結二氧化碳、水汽與\r塵埃組成。若我學院\r時代沒記錯，這代表\r紅色行星春季將至。\r那兒沒太多對我們有\r用之物。

original_en: Sol 5\r               Saturn\r\rScans indicate the planet's core to\rbe made up primarily of liquid \rhydrogen, surrounded by three\rlayers of gaseous clouds. This\rplanet is a lot like Jupiter, but\rthe storms are even more violent.\rNo metals indicated. Nothing of\ruse to the mission.
translation_zh: 太陽系五號\r               土星\r\r掃描顯示行星核心主\r由液態氫構成，外圍\r三層氣態雲。此星酷\r似木星，但風暴更為\r劇烈。未顯示金屬，\r對任務無用。

original_en: Sol 6\r              Jupiter\r\rScans indicate the planet's core to\rbe made up primarily of liquid \rhydrogen, surrounded by three\rlayers of gaseous clouds. Only a\rsmall portion of the lower\ratmosphere holds a temperature\rrange suitable for our\renvironmental suits. The Jovian\rmagnetosphere prevents teletrans\rand more detailed scans.
translation_zh: 太陽系六號\r              木星\r\r掃描顯示行星核心主\r由液態氫構成，外圍\r三層氣態雲。下層大\r氣僅一小部分溫度適\r合我方環境裝。木星\r磁層阻擋跳躍傳送與\r更詳細的掃描。

original_en: Sol 7\r               Uranus\r\rScans indicate a rocky core with\rno heavy metals or life,\rsurrounded by a frozen mantle and\rclouds of Methane ice crystals. No\ruseful materials detected.
translation_zh: 太陽系七號\r               天王星\r\r掃描顯示岩質核心，\r無重金屬亦無生命，\r外圍為凍結地幔與甲\r烷冰晶雲。未偵測到\r有用材料。

original_en: Sol 8\r              Neptune\r\rOne of its moons appears to have a\rMethane atmosphere and oceans of \rliquid Nitrogen. Not the prime \rchoice for a vacation. No reason\rfor contact, Captain.
translation_zh: 太陽系八號\r              海王星\r\r其中一顆衛星似有甲\r烷大氣與液態氮海洋。\r不是渡假首選。艦長，\r無接觸理由。

original_en: Sol 9\r               Pluto\r\rScans indicate Methane atmosphere \rand frozen Methane surface.\rSurface temperature is minus 350\rdegrees. It's a dark and lonely\rplace.  Nothing of value to the\rmission detected.
translation_zh: 太陽系九號\r               冥王星\r\r掃描顯示甲烷大氣與\r凍結甲烷地表。地表\r溫度負三五零度。一\r個黑暗孤寂之地。未\r偵測到對任務有價值\r之物。

original_en: Scanning passes indicate no\rsentient lifeforms currently\rinhabiting this planet. Carbon\rchains detected in the atmosphere\rwould seem to indicate that a\ryield of Earthlike Organics could\rbe mined from our ship.
translation_zh: 掃描顯示此星目前無\r智慧生命棲息。大氣\r中偵測到的碳鏈似乎\r意味著可從本艦開採\r類地有機物。

original_en: There are sizable deposits of\rEarthlike Organics in this\rplanet's strata. Other sources may\rbe located deeper in the core of\rthe planet but we will have to\rwait until those sources are\rforced to the surface.
translation_zh: 此星地層含有大量類\r地有機物。更深的核\r心或藏有其他來源，\r但須等其被擠出地表\r方可取得。

original_en: Background comparison studies\rindicate high levels of gamma\rradiation coming from the planet.\rSamples beamed from the surface\rseem to suggest the presence of\rEarthlike Radioactives.
translation_zh: 背景比對研究顯示此\r星發出高量伽馬輻射。\r從地表傳回的樣本似\r乎指出存有類地放射\r物。

original_en: Strontium levels in the local\renvironment would make teletrans\rto the surface instantly lethal.\rThe good news is that this world\rnaturally produces large\rquantities of Earthlike\rRadioactives.
translation_zh: 當地環境鍶含量過高，\r跳躍傳送至地表將立\r即致命。好消息是此\r星天然產出大量類地\r放射物。

original_en: The crystals displayed on the\rviewscreen would appear to have\rbeen naturally formed by volcanic\ractivity on the planet's surface.\rWe should be able to mine these\rCrystallines in bulk with the\rship's teletrans.
translation_zh: 螢幕上顯示之水晶似\r乎由行星地表火山活\r動天然形成。我們應\r能以本艦跳躍傳送大\r量開採此類晶體。

original_en: This planet appears to be a major\rsource of Crystallines.  If its\rcrystal formation rate remains\rconstant, we should be able to\rmine this planet on a regular\rbasis.
translation_zh: 此星似為晶體主要產\r地。若晶體生成速率\r恆定，我們應可定期\r開採此星。

original_en: We will be unable to beam down to\rthe surface of this world as\rmagnetic effects could disrupt\rteletrans stability. We should be\rable to compensate enough to\rharvest any Heavy Metals that we\rcan detect.
translation_zh: 因磁性效應會干擾跳\r躍傳送穩定性，無法\r傳送至地表。但我們\r應可補償以採收所偵\r測到的重金屬。

original_en: Iron, Copper and Nickel make up\rthe majority of this planet's\rcrust, making it a primary\rproducer for Heavy Metals.\rQuantities are large enough that\rwe should be able to mine here in\rthe future.
translation_zh: 鐵、銅、鎳構成此星\r地殼主要成分，使其\r成為重金屬主要產地。\r蘊藏量足夠日後再來\r開採。

original_en: Large gaps in the upper atmosphere\rmay be the signature of a major\rInert Gas producer. If we can find\rconcentrated quantities then we\rshould be able to mine here.
translation_zh: 高空大氣的大型缺口\r可能是主要惰性氣體\r產地的特徵。若能找\r到濃縮處便可在此開\r採。

original_en: No signs of civilization are\revident on this planet. Analysis\rof the atmosphere indicates the\rpresence of Inert Gases which we\rmay be able to mine.
translation_zh: 此星未見文明跡象。\r大氣分析顯示存有惰\r性氣體，我們或可開\r採。

original_en: Conditions here are favorable for\rthe formation of Soft Metals like\rgold and lead. There should be no\rdifficulty in mining them directly\rfrom orbit.
translation_zh: 此地條件利於黃金、\r鉛等軟金屬形成。直\r接從軌道開採應無困\r難。

original_en: Rich veins of Soft Metals are\ralmost visible from orbit. The\rsupply, for our purposes, is\rnearly unlimited.
translation_zh: 從軌道幾可見軟金屬\r富礦脈。對我方而言\r供應近乎無限。

original_en: Ninety seven percent of this\rworld's surface is submerged by a\rsea of peculiar composition.\rWater, alcohol and various other\rCommon Liquids may be suitable for\rour purposes. Beam down will not\rbe necessary.
translation_zh: 此星百分之九十七地\r表淹沒於組成奇特之\r海。水、酒精及多種\r普通液體或合我方需\r求。無須光束傳送。

original_en: Small pockets of Common Liquids\rare detectable on the surface of\rthis planet. Although we shouldn't\rhave any problems mining here, I\rsuspect that it will take a while\rbefore this planet can generate\rmore.
translation_zh: 地表偵測到零星普通\r液體囊袋。雖開採無\r虞，恐怕此星還需一\r段時間方能再生產更\r多。

original_en: An air content analysis indicates\rthat the atmosphere is largely\rcomposed of an Alien Gas whose\rproperties more closely resemble\rplasma than anything else. These\rgases are among the minerals that\rMoonbase has requested we mine.
translation_zh: 空氣成分分析顯示大\r氣大部分由異星氣體\r組成，其性質較像電\r漿。這些氣體屬於月\r球基地請我們開採的\r礦物之一。

original_en: We are detecting a number of new\relements in gaseous form.  These\rAlien Gases appear to be quite\rabundant and could be extracted\rfrom the atmosphere.
translation_zh: 偵測到多種氣態新元\r素。這些異星氣體相\r當豐富，可從大氣中\r萃取。

original_en: Our scans of the planet surface\rare being reflected back. The\rrecords aboard the ETS indicated\rthat this was sometimes a problem\rwhen scanning worlds with\rconcentrations of Alien Metals.
translation_zh: 我方對地表的掃描遭\r到反射回來。ETS 紀\r錄顯示掃描含高濃度\r異星金屬之星時偶有\r此狀況。

original_en: Judging by the degree of sensor\rdeflection we are encountering,\rthere is a motherload of Alien\rMetals in the crust of this\rplanet. We should literally be\rable to take as much as we can\rcarry!
translation_zh: 根據感應器偏轉程度\r判斷，此星地殼蘊藏\r海量異星金屬。我們\r真能載多少採多少！

original_en: Severe radiation makes this planet\runsuitable to all forms of life\rknown in this arm of the galaxy.\rThe computer does suggest,\rhowever, that Alien Radioactive\rIsotopes could be mined from\rorbit.
translation_zh: 強烈輻射使此星不適\r合本旋臂所知一切生\r命形式。然而電腦建\r議可從軌道開採異星\r放射性同位素。

original_en: A fury of radioactive activity is\rsweeping the planet, making beam\rdown impossible. We still can\rharvest a king's bounty of Alien\rRadioactive isotopes with little\rdifficulty.
translation_zh: 狂暴的輻射活動席捲\r此星，光束傳送無法\r進行。我們仍可輕易\r取得豐厚異星放射性\r同位素。

original_en: We are detecting a number of\rcompounds not found previously in\rcrystalline form. If mined, we may\rbe able to use these Alien\rCrystals in the Replicator.
translation_zh: 偵測到多種前所未見\r的晶態化合物。若開\r採，此異星水晶或可\r用於複製機。

original_en: At first I thought we were\rreceiving transmissions from the\rplanet but I realized the\rinterference was generated by the\rpresence of Alien Crystals.  We\rshould be able to mine them in\rlarge, steady amounts.
translation_zh: 起初我以為收到行星\r傳輸，後才發現干擾\r源是異星水晶。我們\r應能穩定大量開採。

original_en: A close analysis of this biosphere\rreveals several unordered\rlifeforms, none evolved enough for\rcommunication. It is possible,\rhowever, that we can distill Alien\rOrganics from the soil.
translation_zh: 對此生物圈詳細分析\r顯示多種無序生命形\r式，無一進化至可溝\r通程度。但我們仍可\r從土壤中提煉異星有\r機物。

original_en: Judging by the evidence in the\rsoil, this planet must have been\rteeming with life at one time.\rThere's no one to contact now, but\rwe should have an ample supply of\rAlien Organics. We can extract\rthem at a very fast rate.
translation_zh: 從土壤證據判斷，此\r星曾經生機盎然。如\r今雖無人可聯繫，異\r星有機物供應應該充\r裕。可快速萃取。

original_en: Although it would seem to be\rcondensing them at a fantastically\rslow rate, this planet could\rprobably generate Alien Liquids if\rgiven sufficient time between\rextraction visits.
translation_zh: 雖凝結速率慢得驚人，\r若每次採收之間留足\r時間，此星應能生產\r異星液體。

original_en: Although it would seem to be\rcondensing them at a fantastically\rslow rate, this planet could\rprobably generate Alien Liquids if\rgiven sufficient time between\rextraction visits.
translation_zh: 雖凝結速率慢得驚人，\r若每次採收之間留足\r時間，此星應能生產\r異星液體。

original_en: Detecting unusual molecular\rcombinations in the planet's\rcrust. These Uncommon Compounds\rmay be of interest to the\rReplication team back at Moonbase.
translation_zh: 行星地殼偵測到罕見\r分子組合。月球基地\r複製團隊或對此罕見\r化合物有興趣。

original_en: This planet seems to fall well\rinto the mid-range Caneghem\rplanetary scale:  moderate\rtemperatures, average orbit. To\rits note, it has huge deposits of\rUncommon Compounds.
translation_zh: 此星在卡內赫姆行星\r量表中屬中段：溫度\r適中、軌道平凡。值\r得注意的是蘊藏大量\r罕見化合物。

original_en: We may have a few New Elements to\rname when we return to Moonbase.\rWe are detecting atomic structures\rof incredibly high mass numbers.\rWe may be able to mine them with\rour teletrans.
translation_zh: 返回月球基地時或有\r數種新元素可命名。\r偵測到質量數高得驚\r人的原子結構。可以\r跳躍傳送開採。

original_en: This planet's atmospheric\rconditions are undoubtedly\rresponsible for the host of New\rElements present here.  Since the\rcrust is still very active, it\rwill generate new supplies\rrapidly.
translation_zh: 此星大氣條件無疑是\r這眾多新元素存在的\r主因。地殼仍很活躍，\r將快速生產新的供應。

original_en: Scans indicate that the entire \rsurface of this planet is covered \rwith a flow of molten,\rsuperheated, something. I don't\rrecognize the material, but it\rappears to be caught in a state\rjust prior to cooling. The fumes\rare very toxic. Nothing we dare\rbring aboard.
translation_zh: 掃描顯示此星整個地\r表覆蓋著熔融、超熱、\r某種不明物質之流。\r我認不出材質，但似\r乎處於即將冷卻前的\r狀態。煙氣劇毒，無\r一物敢帶上艦。

original_en: Scans indicate lots of organic\rplant life. All in all, it looks\rlike a nice place to have a\rpicnic, but there's nothing of\rparticular interest here. No\rintelligent life indicated, and no\rrare or precious materials.
translation_zh: 掃描顯示大量有機植\r物。整體看來像個郊\r遊好地方，但此處沒\r什麼特別值得注意之\r物。無智慧生命，亦\r無稀有貴重物質。

original_en: Scans show the actual surface of \rthis planet to be the size of a \rlarge asteroid, but with \rapproximately the same mass as \rEarth. The bulk of what we see is\ran extremely thick layer of toxic\rgases that act as an atmosphere.\rThere are no minerals present that\rare useful to us.
translation_zh: 掃描顯示此星實際地\r表僅一大型小行星大\r小，質量卻與地球相\r當。我們所見大部分\r是極厚的有毒氣體層\r作為大氣。無對我方\r有用之礦物。

original_en: 74 percent of the planet's surface\ris covered with snow and ice. They\rappear to be in their own ice age,\ralthough I don't know why I say\r'they.' I have no indications of\rlife anywhere. Any materials we\rcould use would be buried under\rhundreds of feet of ice. It would\rtake us too long to get anything\rout of this place.
translation_zh: 行星百分之七十四地\r表覆蓋冰雪。它們似\r乎正處於自己的冰河\r期，雖然不知為何我\r用『它們』來說。各\r處均無生命跡象。任\r何有用材料皆埋於數\r百呎冰層之下。從此\r處取物耗時太久。

original_en: The surface of this planet appears\rto be only recently cooling down \rfrom severe volcanic activity.\rThere is no vegetation or\ratmosphere present, and a noxious\rgas is seeping from the cooling\rlava. There are no elements here\rwe can't easily get from another\rplanet.
translation_zh: 行星地表似乎才剛從\r激烈火山活動冷卻下\r來。沒有植被或大氣，\r冷卻熔岩滲出有毒氣\r體。此地無任何元素\r是別處難以取得的。

original_en: I can find no traces of water or\rany liquid anywhere on or below\rthe surface of this planet. There\ris no chance for recognizable life\rto have developed here. There\raren't even any precious metals\rburied in the surface. The only\rthing this place would be useful\rfor is a vacation in the desert.
translation_zh: 此星地表上下皆找不\r到水或任何液體之跡。\r此處不可能發展出可\r辨識的生命。地表也\r未埋藏任何貴金屬。\r此地唯一用途大概只\r剩沙漠渡假。

original_en: Violent weather patterns appear \reverywhere. A thick cloud cover \rblocks all light to the surface,\rso there are no indications of \rvegetation. Magnetic disturbances\rin the atmosphere make it very \rdangerous, if not impossible, to \rteletrans down.
translation_zh: 劇烈天氣型態到處可\r見。厚雲層遮蔽所有\r到達地表的光，因此\r無植被跡象。大氣磁\r擾使跳躍傳送即使可\r行也極為危險。

original_en: A very pleasant looking place, \rCaptain. Mostly grass covered with\rlarge, rolling hills and long, \rsweeping plains. The average \rtemperature hovers around 75\rdegrees and there appears to be a\rgentle breeze in the air. No\rintelligent life present.
translation_zh: 艦長，這地方看起來\r很舒適。多覆青草，\r有起伏丘陵與綿長平\r原。均溫約七十五度，\r空中似有微風。無智\r慧生命存在。

original_en: The surface of this, uh... planet\ris a semi-solid gel. It's a jelly \rworld. Scans show large crystal \rformations, but I don't understand\rwhere the pressure required for \rcrystal growth came from. Nothing \rrecognizable shows up on our \rscanners. I don't think we'll find\rany useful materials down there.
translation_zh: 此……呃……星的地\r表是半固態凝膠。果\r凍星球。掃描顯示大\r型晶體結構，但不解\r形成晶體所需壓力來\r自何處。掃描器上沒\r任何可辨識之物。下\r面恐怕找不到有用材\r料。

original_en: Captain, this planet is very \runstable. Scans indicate 83\rpercent of its crust is constantly\rerupting with volcanic activity\rand the mean air temperature is\rbeyond what any of our\renvironmental suits can compensate\rfor. Nothing of interest here. I\rsuggest we move on.
translation_zh: 艦長，此星極不穩定。\r掃描顯示百分之八十\r三地殼持續火山噴發，\r均溫超出我方所有環\r境裝補償極限。此處\r無可觀之物。建議離\r開。

original_en: This world is under the Great\rProtection Treaty signed by the\raffiliates of the Galactic\rEnclave. Seeing that you are not a\rmember we must collect a fee\rbefore you can contact this world.
translation_zh: 此星受銀河飛地成員\r所簽大保護條約管轄。\r既然貴方非成員，我\r們必須收費方允貴方\r接觸此星。

original_en: Greetings, We have been monitoring\ryour situation in the Sol system\rand are very concerned about it.\rOut of sympathy we will reduce the\rvisitation tax for your gallant\rcrew.
translation_zh: 您好，我們一直關注\r貴方太陽系狀況，深\r感憂心。出於同情，\r將為貴勇敢艦組減收\r訪問稅。

original_en: Our planetary space lanes are\ramong the safest in the sector but\rwe can't provide these services\rwithout your help.  With a small\rdonation we can continue to bring\ryou the very best in planetary\rsecurity.
translation_zh: 我方行星航道為星區\r最安全者之一，但需\r貴方相助方能維持。\r一筆小額捐款便可讓\r我們繼續提供最佳行\r星安保。

original_en: WE HAVE SCANNED YOUR VESSEL AND\rDETERMINED THAT YOU MAY POSE A\rTHREAT TO US. WE DEMAND PAYMENT OF\rAN INSURANCE FEE TO ENSURE THE\rGOOD CONDUCT OF YOUR CREW.
translation_zh: 我方已掃描貴艦，\r判定貴方可能構成威\r脅。要求支付保險費\r以擔保貴艦組品行端\r正。

original_en: As negotiators we have been\rauthorized to charge a settlement\rfee for all those interested in\rviewing this planet.
translation_zh: 身為談判代表，\r我方獲授權向所有想\r觀看此星者收取結\r算費。

original_en: Your ship has illegally entered\rthis planetary orbital zone. Under\rthe provisions of the Space\rConducts Mandate, Section 2, you\rwill be required to pay a fine\rbefore visitation.
translation_zh: 貴艦非法進入本行星\r軌道區。依太空行為\r法令第二條，須先繳\r納罰金方可造訪。

original_en: Yearly we have had problems with\rdevelopments of alien viruses\rhere. Because of this we must now\rcharge a new tax to pay for\rimmunization measures. This tax is\rpayable in full before orbiting.
translation_zh: 本地每年皆苦於外星\r病毒。為此我方須加\r收新稅以支應免疫措\r施。此稅須於進入軌\r道前全額繳清。

original_en: Funds are now being collected for\rthe construction of new planetary\rdefenses. Since this measure is\rnecessitated by alien cultures,\rall aliens must pay a tax before\rentering our orbital space.
translation_zh: 現正募款建造新行星\r防禦。既然此舉因外\r星文明而起，所有外\r星人於進入我方軌道\r空域前須繳稅。

original_en: You are commanded to remove your\rinferior transports from this\rorbital space immediately or we\rshall be forced to destroy your\rship and all aboard!
translation_zh: 命爾等立即將劣質運\r輸艦撤出本軌道空域，\r否則我方將被迫摧毀\r貴艦與艦上所有人員！

original_en: Due to a planetary embargo levied\rby the Galactic Enclave,\rvisitation to this planet will not\rbe allowed to any cultures under\rany circumstances.
translation_zh: 因銀河飛地對此星實\r施禁運，無論何種情\r況皆不准任何文明造\r訪此星。

original_en: We are not and will not be\rconsidering any alien races for\rvisitation rights at this time.\rThank you for vacating this space.
translation_zh: 此刻我方並未也不會\r考慮任何外星種族造\r訪。感謝撤離此空域。

original_en: In the interest of galactic\rhealth, it would be best if you\rstayed clear of this planet. We\rbelieve that this planet may be\rcontaminated with germ carrying\rspores.
translation_zh: 為了銀河衛生，建議\r貴方遠離此星。我們\r認為此星恐遭帶菌孢\r子污染。

original_en: We are currently dealing with an\remergency on the dark side of our\rplanet.  All space traffic is\rordered to vacate immediately!
translation_zh: 我方正處理行星暗面\r一場緊急事件。所有\r太空交通須立即撤離！

original_en: Puny Earth ship , you are\rcurrently in violation of Space\rConducts Mandate, Sections 13 -\r26. Because of the severity of\ryour violation we cannot allow you\rcontact with this world.
translation_zh: 渺小的地球艦，貴方\r正違反太空行為法令\r第十三至二十六條。\r鑑於違規之嚴重，不\r准貴方接觸此星。

original_en: We have already legally claimed\rall visitation privileges to this\rplanet for the next ten years. You\rare ordered to leave or be\rdestroyed!
translation_zh: 我方已合法宣稱此星\r未來十年所有訪問特\r權。命爾等離開或被\r摧毀！

original_en: Attention. We refuse to allow any\rorganic creatures access to this\rworld as they have proven to be\renvironmentally hazardous to\recospheres.  Orbital sanitation\refforts will begin immediately.
translation_zh: 注意。我方拒絕讓任\r何有機生物接近此星，\r證實其對生態圈具環\r境危害。軌道清消作\r業即將展開。

original_en: Hail, Earth vessel! We are traders\rplying the lonely spaces of the\rvoid. Truly it is a pleasure to\rmeet you. Perhaps we may be able\rto assist one another.
translation_zh: 地球艦您好！我們是\r穿梭虛空孤寂之地的\r商人。能會面真是榮\r幸。或許我們可互相\r幫助。

original_en: Congratulations on the ingenuity\rof your vessel, aliens. It is rare\rthat we see a vessel of such\rsingular quality and design.\rObviously you are very discerning\rand capable of knowing value. We\rwould like to make you an offer.
translation_zh: 外星人，恭賀貴艦之\r巧思。如此獨到品質\r與設計實屬罕見。顯\r然貴方眼光獨到，懂\r得鑑賞價值。我方願\r提一份提案。

original_en: It is a sad fact that we must do\rour business here, suspended in\rcold starlight and dead vacuum.\rPerhaps we can meet someday under\rmore pleasant circumstances. I\roffer my humble services as a\rtrader.
translation_zh: 可悲我方必須在此寒\r冷星光與死寂真空中\r做生意。或許某日能\r在更愜意的場合相見。\r在下身為商人略盡綿\r薄之力。

original_en: Please do not attack. We are a\rpeaceful trading ship on our\rstandard route. I don't have much\rto offer at the moment but I would\rbe willing to work with you.
translation_zh: 請勿攻擊。我們是走\r標準航線的和平商船。\r雖目前所能提供不多，\r但願與貴方合作。

original_en: Many greetings. We have seen much\rand traded heartily in the past\rwith aliens such as yourself. If\rwe might interest you in something\rplease do not hesitate to ask.\rAlways it is desirable to turn a\rprofit.
translation_zh: 諸多問候。過往我們\r見多識廣，亦曾與貴\r方這般外星人熱絡交\r易。若有興趣請別客\r氣。獲利向來是好事。

original_en: Is there something we can do for\ryou? We are in a hurry, so we must\rmake this exchange quickly if\rthere is one to be made at all.
translation_zh: 需要我方效勞嗎？我\r們有急事，若要交易\r就得快。

original_en: Our prices are unfair, exploitive\rand outrageous but we seem to be\rhappy enough with what profits we\rturn. None of our customers have\rever complained about the quality\rof our goods or our information.
translation_zh: 我方價格不公、剝削、\r離譜，但我們對所獲\r利潤心滿意足。從未\r有客戶抱怨過商品或\r情報品質。

original_en: Earth ship, you are in violation\rof occupied space! We order you to\rvacate this region immediately or\rbe destroyed.
translation_zh: 地球艦，貴方侵犯占\r領空域！命爾等立即\r撤離本區，否則摧毀。

original_en: Ah, Earthlings! We have heard\rabout the mishap with your planet\rand it amuses us. It is our\rsincere hope that you can pilot a\rstarship with more proficiency\rthan you guard a planet. Prepare\rfor battle!
translation_zh: 啊，地球人！我們聽\r聞你們行星之厄，覺\r得頗為有趣。誠心希\r望你們駕艦比守護星\r球更熟練。準備戰鬥！

original_en: We do not like the way that you\rlook nor the way that you speak.\rTurn your ship towards your star\rhumans and flee if you value your\rlives.
translation_zh: 我們不喜歡你們的長\r相，也不喜歡你們的\r說話方式。人類啊，\r若惜命就掉頭奔向你\r們的恆星逃命去吧。

original_en: You wish to speak to us? How\rinteresting. It is so rare when\rone gets the opportunity to talk\rwith the dead, for dead is what\ryou very soon shall be if you do\rnot leave the sector immediately.
translation_zh: 你想對我們說話？真\r有趣。難得有機會與\r死人交談，因為若你\r不立即離開星區，很\r快便是死人。

original_en: A battle would please me to no end\rbut I am obligated first to order\ryou to leave. Of course if you\rdecide not to go then we shall\rhave no other choice than to\rfire...
translation_zh: 一場戰鬥能讓我樂無\r止盡，但我有義務先\r命你離開。當然，若\r你決定不走，那我們\r別無選擇只能開火……

original_en: We are targeting your ship for\rdestruction, Earth vessel. A\rpreliminary analysis of your\ractivities has determined that you\rmay be hostile. For the good of\rthe galaxy your ship shall be\rdestroyed.
translation_zh: 地球艦，已將貴艦列\r為摧毀目標。初步分\r析貴方活動，判定恐\r有敵意。為銀河之利，\r貴艦將被摧毀。

original_en: To battle we fly and our crew is\ryet to be blooded. We shall give\ryou the honor of honing our\rskills. It shall be an honor to\rkill you!
translation_zh: 我等馳赴戰陣，艦組\r尚未沾染戰血。賜你\r磨練我輩武藝之榮。\r殺你即榮耀！

original_en: You waddle the space lanes like a\rpregnant Scroe bloodsow!  Perhaps\rit is time that we relieved you of\ra little of your excess weight.\rSurrender your cargo or die!
translation_zh: 你這笨重的太空旅人，\r搖擺得像懷孕的史庫\r血豬！是時候替你減\r輕點負擔了。交出貨\r物，否則死路一條！

original_en: I enjoy this none more than you\rshall, Earth creatures but these\rtimes have forced my hand...I\rorder that you give over your\rcargo or we shall have to destroy\ryou.
translation_zh: 地球生物，我和你一\r樣不享受這事，但時\r勢逼我出手……命你\r交出貨物，否則我們\r必須摧毀你們。

original_en: Let's not make this any more\rcomplicated than necessary.  You\rhave something I want and I would\rprefer not to have to destroy you\rto get it. Be civilized and do as\rI say and we shall both be\rhappier.
translation_zh: 別把事情弄得比必要\r更複雜。你有我想要\r之物，我也不願毀掉\r你來取得。理智點照\r辦，雙方皆歡。

original_en: Your needs are irrelevant Earth\rship. We need the following goods\rand our scans have detected them\raboard your vessel. Give them up\ror you shall be destroyed.
translation_zh: 地球艦，貴方需求無\r關緊要。我方需以下\r貨物，且掃描已偵測\r貴艦載有。交出，否\r則摧毀。

original_en: Your weapons are inferior, your\rshields thin and your engines poor\rat best against us. No traders us\rbut the best pirates in this\rspiral arm! Transfer the items we\rdemand and we may spare your\rlives.
translation_zh: 你武器低劣，護盾薄\r弱，引擎相對我方差\r勁。我等非商人，乃\r本旋臂最佳海盜！轉\r移所需之物或可饒命。

original_en: No negotiation. Hand over your\rcargo or prepare to meet whatever\rgods you may worship.
translation_zh: 不談判。交出貨物，\r否則準備見你所拜之\r神。

original_en: It appears that this will be even\reasier than we had hoped!  How\rrefreshing! Arrange to give us\ryour cargo. Of course, if you wish\rto fight, that might provide a\rpleasant diversion as well. It's\ryour choice!
translation_zh: 看來這比我們預想更\r輕鬆！真清爽！安排\r交出貨物。當然若想\r打，倒也算個愉快消\r遣。隨你選！

original_en: We've prepared you as best we can.\rThere are eight components out there, pieces\rto a puzzle whose solution may mean nothing\rless than the salvation of the Earth itself.\rThese items, the N.I.C.T.U., AlgoCam,\rK-Beam, Harmonic Resonator, Mass Converter,\rGravitic Compressor, Krupp Shields, and\rAlgiebian Crystals, these are all needed to\rreconstruct the Centauri Device. Your search\rcould start nearly anywhere but we have\rdetermined that Alpha Centauri may be the\rbest candidate for first contact because of\ractivity detected there.  Good luck!
translation_zh: 我們已盡力為各位準備。\r外頭有八件元件，是一道謎題\r的拼圖，其解或許意味著拯救\r地球本身。這些物品 N.I.C.T.U.、\r阿戈卡、K豆、諧振共振器、\r質量轉換器、重力壓縮器、\r克魯伯護盾、阿吉比安水晶，\r皆為重組半人馬裝置所需。各\r位幾乎可從任何地方開始尋找，\r但我方判定半人馬座阿爾法因\r偵測到活動，或為第一次接觸\r最佳候選。祝好運！

original_en: Welcome back to Moonbase, crew. Chief\rEngineer Pleadwell has asked that I thank\ryou for the retrieval of the alien technical\rdocuments. Everyone in the Alien\rTechnologies Lab is apparently very excited\rby what they have seen so far and they say\rthat the information seems very promising\rfor us. If you can capture further alien\ritems for us, we may begin to duplicate\rtheir laser-based weapons as well as some\rother higher tech objects. Keep up the good\rwork.
translation_zh: 艦組，歡迎回月球基地。\r普利德威爾總工請我代為感謝\r各位取回外星技術文件。外星\r科技實驗室全員顯然對所見興\r奮不已，表示資訊對我方頗具\r前景。若各位能再帶回更多外\r星物品，我們或可開始複製其\r雷射武器與其他更高科技物。\r再接再厲。

original_en: Always a pleasure to see you back here in\rone piece, team! Again Maria Pleadwell\rthanks you for retrieving these new alien\rtechnical documents. It took a little while\rlonger for us to wade through all the data\rbut it appears to be as valuable as the last\rclutch of documents you brought us.\rAssuming we have all the proper elements and\rprototypes to work from, we may be able to\rproduce even heavier weapons for you to use.\rKeep this up and we'll be as advanced as the\rmost advanced races in the galaxy!
translation_zh: 各位平安歸來總是叫人欣\r慰！瑪麗亞．普利德威爾再次\r感謝各位取回這些新的外星技\r術文件。我們耗時稍久才消化\r所有資料，但似乎與上批同樣\r珍貴。倘若我們備有所有合適\r元素與原型可資參照，或可生\r產更重型武器供各位使用。如\r此下去，我們將與銀河最先進\r的種族並駕齊驅！

original_en: I can tell that this mission is beginning\rto wear on you, but hang in there. As long\ras you can keep bringing us back these\rtechnical documents, we can build better\rships and weapons for you.  You'll be\rpleased to know that the latest technical\rplans that you brought back are fantastic!\rAlien Technologies thinks they can vastly\rimprove the efficiency of the technologies\rwe already possess and at the same time add\ra few new items to our Replicator's data\rbanks.  How's that for good news!
translation_zh: 看得出這任務開始消磨各\r位，但請撐住。只要各位持續\r帶回這些技術文件，我們便能\r為各位打造更佳的艦與武器。\r各位會樂於知道最新帶回的技\r術圖紙太精采了！外星科技組\r認為可大幅提升我方既有科技\r效率，同時於複製機資料庫新\r增數項物品。這算不算好消息！

original_en: We thought that we knew everything there was\rto know until you brought us the latest\rbatch of technical plans! I don't know if\ryou have had a chance to look them over, but\rwhat we've seen so far is elegant enough to\rbe frightening.  The list of subjects reads\rlike a Christmas List for the Alien\rTechnologies Lab: Microgravitics, Non-Linear\rWave Propagating, Offensive Teletransing...\rWe should be able to manufacture weapons\rthat match the most powerful things that we\rhave seen!
translation_zh: 我們原以為知道一切，直到各\r位帶回最新一批技術圖！不知\r各位是否抽空翻過，目前所見\r優雅得令人發毛。主題清單儼\r然是外星科技實驗室的耶誕禮\r物清單：微重力學、非線性波\r傳播、攻擊型跳躍傳送……\r我們應能製造可匹敵所見最強\r武器！

original_en: Congratulations on the retrieval of the\rAlgiebian Crystal, team! The Reconstruction\rpeople say that it will provide the power\rfor the Centauri Device once fully\rreconstructed. Of course that depends on you\rbringing us more parts! Before you leave,\ryou might want to know that Intelligence\rsays that Kornephoros Sector may be a good\rplace to look next if you haven't already\rventured there.  Tactically we should be\rcapable of handling them.
translation_zh: 恭賀取回阿吉比安水晶！重組\r小組表示，一旦完全重組，水\r晶將為半人馬裝置供能。當然，\r這仍取決於各位帶回更多零件！\r離開前，情報組指出庫尼弗洛\r斯星區若各位尚未涉足，或為\r下一個好去處。戰術上我方應\r能應付。

original_en: Now that you've brought back the Gravitic\rCompressor, we're another step closer to\rgetting the Earth back from limbo! We\rhaven't had a chance to hook it up yet but\rit is very similar to the alien technology\rthat we've encountered so far. There\rshouldn't be any problems. Incidentally, you\rmay want to check out a disturbance in the\rAlhena sector. There seems to be a lot of\ractivity going on there.
translation_zh: 各位帶回重力壓縮器，我們離\r救回地球又近一步！尚未接上\r測試，但與目前所見外星科技\r極為相近，應無問題。另順帶\r一提，建議查看阿赫納星區一\r處擾動。那兒似乎活動頻繁。

original_en: The Reconstruction Team wanted me to relay\rtheir thanks for the retrieval of the Mass\rConverter. It operates much like a large\rscale Teletrans but we're not entirely\rcertain what its purpose is when the\rCentauri Device is activated. In other news,\rwe're receiving a lot of chatter from Caroli\rSector. One of our decoders thinks that he\rheard something about a Gravitic Compressor!
translation_zh: 重組小組託我代轉感謝，因取\r回質量轉換器。其運作頗似大\r型跳躍傳送，但半人馬裝置啟\r動時其用途仍未完全明朗。另\r一則消息：卡羅利星區傳來大\r量通訊。我方某解碼員自認聽\r到關於重力壓縮器的內容！

original_en: Great work, team. The Algo Cam you've   \rbrought us is a very important part of the\rdevice. I only wish I knew enough about it\rto tell you what it does. Oh well, that's\rwhat the guys in the lab get paid for.\rReconstruction of the alien device is\rprogressing very nicely and all of here at\rMoonbase are very hopeful that we will be\rable to recover our lost planet. By the\rway the people in the Research Lab would\rlike to see you when you have the time.
translation_zh: 幹得好。各位帶回的阿戈卡是\r裝置極重要的部件。可惜我所\r知不足，無法告知其作用。唉，\r反正實驗室那群人領薪水就是\r做這事。外星裝置重組進展順\r利，月球基地全體都很期望能\r找回失落的行星。對了，研究\r室那邊有空時想見各位。

original_en: It appears as though we can cross the\rHarmonic Resonator off the list of items\rthat we need! Very well done, crew! After\rgoing over the device and comparing it to\rthe alien schematic, we know that this\rdevice actually generates the wave that will\ropen the wormhole door! And while I'm on the\rsubject, we have detected a wormhole like\rdisturbance in Izar Sector. Maybe you can\rfind some answers there.
translation_zh: 看來諧振共振器可從我們所需\r清單上劃掉了！艦組做得真好！\r把裝置與外星圖比對後，我們\r知道此裝置實際上會產生開啟\r蟲洞之門的波！既然提到，我\r方在伊薩星區偵測到類似蟲洞\r的擾動。或許各位能在那裡找\r到答案。

original_en: The K-Beam that you delivered is quite a\rtoy! It's like a gravitational grappling\rhook that the Centauri Device will use to\rstabilize the dimensional door. Needless to\rsay, the Reconstruction team was very\rpleased with it! Intelligence has been\rcombing through the ETS and they definitely\rknow that you can get a Harmonic Resonator\rsomewhere in Sector Ankaq. Watch yourself\rthough, it's a fairly advanced sector.
translation_zh: 各位送來的 K豆真是個好玩\r意！像是重力抓鉤，半人馬裝\r置將以此穩定維度之門。不消\r說，重組小組很滿意！情報組\r一直在梳理 ETS，確定可在\r安卡克星區某處取得諧振共振\r器。但要當心，那是相當先進\r的星區。

original_en: As always, your efforts are outstanding!\rNow that we have the N.I.C.T.U. in place we\rare much closer to having the Centauri\rDevice reconstructed. Hopefully we can start\rsimulations studies on it soon. As\rdistasteful a duty as it may seem, I want to\rask you to try to explore the Alnasl Sector\rif you have not done so already. The\rtechnology evident there seems very similar\rto that of the wrecked ETS!
translation_zh: 一如既往，各位的努力傑出！\r既然 N.I.C.T.U. 已就位，\r距離半人馬裝置重組完成更近\r了。希望能盡快開始模擬研究。\r雖此任務可能令人厭，我仍想\r請各位若尚未探索阿納斯爾星\r區，請去試試。那裡的科技似\r與失事 ETS 極為相似！

original_en: The Krupp Shields that you retrieved appear\rto be in very good condition.  We will\rinstall it on the Centauri Device prototype\ras soon as we finish some last minute\radjustments to it. In the meanwhile, you may\rwant to venture into Sector Ankaq.  I have\rconferred with Wade and we think that we\rshould be able to face the pirates in that\rsector with a small modicum of risk. I wish\ryou all well.
translation_zh: 各位取回的克魯伯護盾狀況頗\r佳。我們完成最後微調後將立\r即安裝至半人馬裝置原型上。\r在此同時，建議各位探訪安卡\r克星區。我已與韋德商議，認\r為以小幅風險可面對該星區海\r盜。祝各位一切順利。

original_en: When once I landed on Talitha 2, a\rlocal trader told me of a secret\rpath that led through the bush\rgardens and wound its way to an\rentrance in the side of the\rbuilding.  The path is surrounded\rby danger, so be careful.
translation_zh: 我曾登陸塔利薩二號，\r一當地商人告訴我，\r一條密徑穿過灌木花\r園，蜿蜒至建築側面\r一處入口。沿途險阻\r環伺，務必小心。

original_en: They Who Converse are strange ones\rindeed. The only way to talk to\rthem is by using a thing they call\ran Imastyl. If you ever find\ryourself on Subra 2, just look\raround the trees and you're bound\rto find one.  You'll hold no\ruseful dialogue without it.
translation_zh: 「會交談者」確實怪\r異。與其交談唯一方\r式是用他們稱為伊馬\r斯泰的東西。若你身\r處蘇布拉二號，繞著\r樹找定能尋得一件。\r沒它就毫無對話可言。

original_en: KooShee 1 is a dank and lonely \rplace. I once was there with three\rshipmates and we were immediately \rseparated for the longest time, \rleaving me to search them out. If \rthis fate should befall you,\rsearch for the secret door at the\redge of the stream. I never found\rit myself, but I hear rumors of a\rspecial mirror shard lost in the\rcorridors.
translation_zh: 庫希一號既潮濕又孤\r寂。我曾與三名艦組\r同伴前往，立即被分\r散許久，得自行尋人。\r若你也遭此厄運，請\r在溪流邊尋找密門。\r我自己沒找到，但聽\r聞通道中遺失一片特\r殊鏡片。

original_en: The Hall of Shame, in the \rPresidential Complex on Algeiba 4,\rcontains a single bust with eyes \rmade of Algeiban Crystals. If you \rcan deactivate the force field,\rthey will be yours. Good luck to\ryou. I finally gave up.
translation_zh: 阿吉比四號總統綜合\r區的恥辱廳內有一尊\r胸像，眼珠是阿吉比\r安水晶。若能關閉力\r場便歸你。祝你好運。\r我最終放棄了。

original_en: Never before have I seen the likes\rof you among the stars. Your kind \rmust be new to deep space travel. \rAllow me to offer some advice...\rTry to communicate with whoever\ryou come across. If their\rintentions are hostile, you'll\rknow it soon enough.  And take\rheed to what you are told.  Seldom\rwill you be purposefully mislead.
translation_zh: 我在群星間從未見過\r你這樣的。你的族群\r必是深空旅行新手。\r容我獻策……試著與\r所遇者交流。若其意\r圖敵對，你很快會知\r道。並注意聽人說了\r什麼。鮮少有人故意\r誤導你。

original_en: Here's a piece of advice for you\rin a combat situation. Concentrate\ryour firepower on a single enemy\runtil it is destroyed. Spreading\ryourself too thin while in battle\rwill only shorten your stay with\rus among the stars.
translation_zh: 給你一句戰鬥忠告。\r集中火力於單一敵人\r直至摧毀。戰中分散\r兵力只會縮短你在星\r海中與我們同行的時\r間。

original_en: Don't worry if you are having a \rdifficult time knowing where to\rgo.  You are new here. Follow\rmerchant ships to find new places\rto explore.
translation_zh: 若不知該何去何從別\r擔心。你是這裡的新\r人。跟著商船便能找\r到新地方探索。

original_en: Pirates are a problem all over.\rYou can shoot them out of the\rstars all you want, but you have\rto blow up their base to rid a\rsector of their presence.
translation_zh: 海盜到處橫行。你可\r盡情把他們轟出星空，\r但要徹底擺脫一星區\r的海盜，必須炸掉他\r們的基地。

original_en: This may be a handy piece of\radvice if you happen to find\ryourself lost in the sewers of\rRutilicus 2. Each of the levers\rthere make the walls shift. And\rwatch out for the green slime.\rIt's toxic to your kind.
translation_zh: 若你迷失在盧提利庫\r斯二號的下水道，這\r或許有用。那裡每根\r控桿都會移動牆面。\r另留心綠色黏液，對\r你族劇毒。

original_en: Eltanin 7 is always having\rproblems with their communications\rarray. They can't keep the snow\roff it long enough to maintain\rcontact. Why they would want to\rlive there I'll never know. Find\rthe array and use a Thermaul to\rclear it. That should enable their\rcommunications system.
translation_zh: 艾爾塔寧七號的通訊\r陣列老是出狀況。雪\r清不掉，無法長期維\r持聯絡。他們為何想\r住那兒我永遠不懂。\r找到陣列，用熱錘清\r除，應能啟動其通訊\r系統。

original_en: I had a nasty time of it on Sabik\r1 a year ago, trying to find my\rway around. These infernal levers\rwith words are on the walls\reverywhere. Switch the levers so\rthey form a certain sentence and\rthe locked elevator door will let\ryou in.
translation_zh: 一年前我在薩比克一\r號吃了不少苦頭，到\r處找路。牆上滿是該\r死的有字控桿。把控\r桿撥成特定句子，鎖\r住的電梯門便會放你\r進去。

original_en: The Dantea on Sabik I eat Skocha\rroots to make their bodies\rtolerant to radiation. They value\rSkocha higher than Diamonds.
translation_zh: 薩比克一號的丹特人\r食斯科查根使身體耐\r輻射。他們視斯科查\r比鑽石更貴重。

original_en: The most powerful weapon in the \runiverse lies entombed in the \rsepulchres of Kornephoros 3.\rSearch for it in the central tomb\rof the Last Defenders Tomb Room.\rYou will need to find the last\rstanza of the Defender's Tale to\robtain your prize.
translation_zh: 宇宙最強武器封藏於\r庫尼弗洛斯三號的墓\r穴中。在最後守衛者\r墓室的中央墓中尋找。\r須尋得守衛者之歌的\r末段方可獲得獎賞。

original_en: Here's a little tip for you I\rpicked up after years of pirat...\reh, trading in this sector. The\rTrader Warehouse on Kochab 2 has a\rprivate and secret room in it\rwhere you will be able to acquire\rsome very helpful things. Use the\rUnilock to get in.
translation_zh: 給你個小提示，我在\r此星區多年海盜……\r呃，貿易得來的。柯\r卡布二號商人倉庫內\r有一私密暗室，可取\r得頗有用之物。用萬\r鎖進去。

original_en: Search out new technology in each \rsector of space you explore. There\rare tech plans for new ships and \rweapons to be found in most. It\rwill be the key to your survival\ras you unravel the mysteries of\rthe universe.
translation_zh: 在你探索的每個星區\r尋找新科技。多數星\r區都有新艦與武器的\r技術圖。這將是你揭\r開宇宙奧祕時生存的\r關鍵。

original_en: If you find a weapon made at a \rhigher tech level than you have \rreached, use it sparingly. You\rwill be unable to duplicate the\rweapon until you reach that tech\rlevel.
translation_zh: 若你發現高於自身科\r技層級所造之武器，\r節用之。在達到該層\r級前無法複製。

original_en: You need a Work Permit to do \ranything useful on Alula 4. If\rasked to find some Lozam to prove\ryour worth, there's some hidden on\ra flower pot. I put it there so if\rI ever returned I'd be able to get\ra permit quickly. Feel free to use\rit if you wish, but I don't\rremember exactly which pot it's in\rso you'll have to do a little\rsearching.
translation_zh: 在阿魯拉四號要做任\r何有用之事都需工作\r許可證。若被要求找\r洛贊以證明能耐，花\r盆裡藏了一些。我放\r那兒是怕日後再來能\r快速辦證。隨意取用，\r但我不記得具體哪只\r盆，你得自己找找。

original_en: The Zoo on Merak 1 is an\rinteresting place to spend some\rtime, but you need to have an\rengineer with you to operate the\rteleport pads. They're just a\rlittle too complicated for the\ranimal of average intelligence.
translation_zh: 梅拉克一號的動物園\r是個有趣去處，但須\r帶工程師同行才能操\r作傳送墊。對一般智\r力的動物來說太複雜\r了點。

original_en: I worked in the Miniaturization\rLab on Cor-Caroli 1 some time ago.\rBlasted thing was always breaking \rdown. Always had to drop in a gold\rwire to fix a break in the\rcircuit, then switch two of the\rchips to make the machine work. I\rbet they never even fixed those\rproblems.
translation_zh: 先前我在科爾卡羅利\r一號的微縮實驗室工\r作。該死的機器老壞。\r老得放金線修電路斷\r點，再換兩塊晶片才\r能運作。我敢說那些\r毛病到現在還沒修好。

original_en: Have you ever been to the temple\ron Denebola 4? It is full of those\rsleeping Eldarin beasts. Horrible \rlooking creatures. And you sure \rdon't want to be around when they \rcome out of hibernation. To leave \rthe temple you must operate a \rstrange lock and key mechanism\rmade up of orbs and pillars.
translation_zh: 你去過丹尼伯拉四號\r的神廟嗎？裡面盡是\r沉睡的艾爾達林獸。\r長相恐怖。你絕不會\r想在牠們冬眠醒來時\r還在那兒。要離開神\r廟須操作一種由球體\r與石柱組成的怪異鎖\r鑰機關。

original_en: There are sixteen different\rminerals to be found out here in\rspace. Minerals that must be used\rto manufacture the new\rtechnologies you will come across.\rYou will have to search out the\rmore exotic ones.
translation_zh: 太空中可尋十六種不\r同礦物。這些礦物為\r製造你將遇到之新科\r技所必需。較奇特者\r須自行尋訪。

original_en: Build specific applications into\rthe design of your ships. Make\rseparate ships for war,\rexploration, and freighting. Too\rmuch generalization will leave you\rweak and vulnerable.
translation_zh: 在艦艇設計中納入專\r門用途。分別打造作\r戰、探索、運輸用艦。\r過度通用會讓你又弱\r又脆。

original_en: To stay alive out here, temper\ryour reactions to unexpected\rsituations.  Fight when it is\rnecessary to fight, but run when\rit is best to do so. You cannot\rsave your planet unless you can\rsave yourself. If you are not\rstrong enough to face a foe, run\raway and return when you are more \rpowerful.
translation_zh: 要在外頭活下來，請\r節制對突發狀況的反\r應。該打就打，該逃\r則逃。若不能自保便\r救不了你的星球。若\r不足以對抗敵人，先\r逃，待更強再回來。

original_en: Be choosey when cloning\rreplacements for your crew. Accept\ronly specimens that are highly\rskilled for your weapons.
translation_zh: 複製艦組替補者時要\r挑剔。只收與你武器\r搭配技能高的樣本。

original_en: Heed my warning. Do not visit \rProcyon 3 until there is great \rstrength in your weapons and\rarmor.  There is much of danger to\rbe found there. If you look long\renough you will find a Battle\rLaser, one way or another.
translation_zh: 聽我警告。武裝未強\r盛勿訪普羅西恩三號。\r那兒險境重重。若找\r夠久，總會以某種方\r式覓得戰鬥雷射。

original_en: The keeper of the Leader's Stone\rwas last known to be on a cruise\rpassing by Capella 1, but no\rcontact has been made with the\rship in some time. The Leader's\rStone is necessary for your tasks,\rso you may wish to search for it.
translation_zh: 守領者之石的看守人\r最後行蹤已知是搭一\r艘掠過卡佩拉一號的\r巡航船，但近期無聯\r絡。領者之石為你的\r任務所需，建議尋訪。

original_en: The Claims Officer on Alhena 8 is\ra forgetful fellow. He's always \rmisplacing his validation stamp,\rand what's worse is he drops it in\rthe same place every time. If you\rneed him to validate a deed,\rchances are you'll have to find\rhis stamp first.  A flight\rrecorder will open the door to\rwhere he loses it.
translation_zh: 阿赫納八號的權狀官\r是個健忘的傢伙。他\r老把鑑證印章弄丟，\r更糟的是每次都掉在\r同一處。若需他鑑證\r文件，多半得先幫他\r找回印章。一具飛行\r紀錄器可打開他丟印\r章那間屋子的門。

original_en: The doors of the diplomatic\rstation on Hyades 1 are operated\rby slider panels found on the\rwalls. This information may prove\ruseful if ever you need to go\rthere.
translation_zh: 海雅德斯一號外交站\r的門由牆上的滑桿面\r板操控。若你需要去\r那兒，這資訊或許有\r用。

original_en: Use grenades with caution. They\rare very effective against groups\rof foes, but watch your range.\rGrenades work just as effectively\ragainst any of your own people who\rget caught in the blast area.
translation_zh: 用手榴彈要謹慎。對\r成群敵人極有效，但\r留意距離。對自家人\r落入爆風範圍同樣有\r效。

original_en: There is solidarity among beings\ron planets. If you fire at a\rbeing, others within sight are\rlikely to come to its aid. It may\rbe best to do your killing in dark\rcorners.
translation_zh: 行星上的眾生有同類\r意識。若你射擊某者，\r視野內的其他人很可\r能來援。最好在暗角\r動手。

original_en: If there is a starbase in a\rsector, it may be worth checking\rout. Bases are seldom established\rin areas where there is nothing of\rvalue to protect.
translation_zh: 若星區有星基地便值\r得查看。基地少設於\r無價值可護的區域。

original_en: Bases and their escorts do not\rhave to be destroyed in one\rattack. If need be, and it \rprobably will, you may retreat to \rrepair your damage and return to \rfinish your devastation. What\rships you have destroyed will\rstill be gone.
translation_zh: 基地與護衛不必一次\r打掉。需要時，多半\r你會需要，可先撤退\r修復損傷再回頭完成\r殲滅。已摧毀之艦仍\r然消失。

original_en: Any fool knows that you should use\ra Sonic Pinchers on pipes that are\rjutting from walls.
translation_zh: 任何傻子都知道牆上\r突出的管子要用音波\r鉗。

original_en: The jungle planet of RasalMothal 5\ris in terrible danger of being \rdevastated by storms. Inside the \rpyramid is the key to calming the \rweather. In the jungle there is a \rmaintenance shed. Fix the wires\rthat have been chewed on by Slieth\rto enter the pyramid.
translation_zh: 叢林行星拉薩摩薩五\r號正面臨被風暴摧毀\r的危機。金字塔內藏\r有平息天氣之鑰。叢\r林中有間維修棚。修\r復被斯萊絲咬壞的電\r線方能進入金字塔。

original_en: On RasalMothal 5 there is a square\rarea of strange design outside the\rcontrol room. You must manipulate \rthe tiles of the square to look\rlike a claw-shaped ship to gain\raccess to the control room.
translation_zh: 拉薩摩薩五號控制室\r外有塊設計怪異的方\r形區域。須操作方格\r拼成爪形船的模樣才\r能進入控制室。

original_en: The domes of Zaurak 2 are full of \rteleports. It is very easy to get \rlost while popping around. It may\rbe wise to drop objects to mark\rwhere you've already been. When\ryou find the pumping station, a\rspecial tool must be used to\rreactivate the water supply.
translation_zh: 佐拉克二號的圓頂內\r滿是傳送器。跳來跳\r去極易迷路。掉落物\r品標記走過處乃明智\r之舉。找到抽水站時\r須用特殊工具重啟供\r水。

original_en: On Diphda 4 they play a nasty game\rcalled Scorch. Only the bravest \rplay, for pain is the penalty for \rlosing. Very few beat the machine.\rBut... I know a way to win. There\ris a switch buried somewhere in\rthe snow outside. Throw the switch\rand the Scorch machine will throw\rthe game.
translation_zh: 迪夫達四號玩一種叫\r「焦」的惡劣遊戲。\r只有最勇者敢玩，因\r輸者受痛罰。極少有\r人勝過機器。但……\r我知道贏法。外面雪\r中某處埋著一個開關。\r扳下開關，焦機便會\r放水。

original_en: Go see the Giate on Rana. He will \rtell you of the needs of this \rsector. His words must be followed\rto neutralize the white dwarf that\ris threatening this sector.
translation_zh: 去找拉納上的吉亞特。\r他會告訴你此星區的\r需要。須遵其言才能\r中和威脅本星區的白\r矮星。

original_en: Greetings, Humans. I have some \rinformation that may set your\rminds at ease, at least for the\rtime being. Our latest scans show\rthat your planet is still safe and\rintact. We wish you luck on your \rquest to reclaim it.
translation_zh: 人類，您好。我有些\r訊息或可讓你們暫時\r安心。我方最新掃描\r顯示你們的行星仍安\r全完好。祝你們找回\r的征途好運。

original_en: If your knowledge is not great \renough to carry you through the \rtasks that lie ahead, there are \rlegendary beings of great\rintellect that may be called upon\rto give assistance. They can be\rreached by your standard\rtelecommunications consoles. Their\raccess code is (818) 999-0607.
translation_zh: 若你的知識不足以撐\r完前路任務，有些智\r識淵博的傳奇存在可\r以召喚相助。可由標\r準通訊台聯絡。存取\r碼為 (818) 999-0607。

original_en: If you should need to get into the\rtemple on Ankaq 1, pay tribute to \rthe Queen Muniarc on Fomalhaut 6. \rShe will give you the key you\rneed.
translation_zh: 若你需要進入安卡克\r一號神廟，向佛瑪豪\r六號的穆尼亞克女王\r獻貢。她會給你所需\r之鑰。

original_en: In the temple on Ankaq 1, the \rspheres of Awa, Themi, Ryth and \rHarmon have been stolen away and \rscattered throughout this sector. \rThey must be returned to their \rproper resting places in the\rfloor.  While on Ankaq you may\rwish to look for the Comnet which\rwas lost there.
translation_zh: 安卡克一號神廟內阿\r瓦、賽米、雷斯、哈\r蒙之球皆遭竊，散落\r於本星區各處。須歸\r回地面相應安放之位。\r在安卡克時，建議尋\r找該地遺失的通訊網。

original_en: Shadowside is a dark world of \rintrigue. The Cyberpunks and the \rTschi Tai are always looking to\rgain advantage over each other.\rHeed these three things - Take\rEinjhi Codebreaker's translations\rto Bit. If you find any wetware,\rtake it to Socketball. Find\rwet suits for your group. They may\rbe needed later.
translation_zh: 影面是個密謀重重的\r黑暗世界。賽博龐克\r與齊采人總在互鬥取\r利。記住三件事：把\r艾因吉破譯員的翻譯\r交給比特。如得任何\r溼件，交給插座球。\r為隊伍備溼裝。或許\r日後用得到。

original_en: Nashira 3 is a shimmering place of\renticing waters. Don't try to swim\rwithout a wet suit or you will be \rforever lost in the lightless, \rbottomless deep. But you will need\rto swim to find the real life and \rcivilization of this wet world.
translation_zh: 納希拉三號是片誘人\r的閃爍之水。沒溼裝\r別下水，否則永困無\r光無底深淵。但要找\r到此水世界的真實生\r命與文明，須得游下\r去。

original_en: On Nashira 3, the only way to\rescape with the Sphere of Themi is\rto leave a counterfeit sphere in\rits place. The Seadudes are too\rstupid to know the difference.
translation_zh: 在納希拉三號，要帶\r賽米之球逃離只能留\r一個假球替代。海漢\r蠢得分不出差異。

original_en: On Alrai 2, in the chambers of CU,\rthere is a picture hanging on the \rwall. Search this picture closely \rand a hidden passage may be \rrevealed.
translation_zh: 阿萊二號 CU 的房裡，\r牆上掛著一幅畫。仔\r細查畫，或現密道。

original_en: In this sector there once lived a \rmerchant who grew very rich by \rselling video entertainment to \rintelligent beings. He was loved\rby all. Then one day Pirates came\rand copied his goods and\rdistributed them freely throughout\rthe galaxy. As a result of this\rthievery, the merchant's wife and\rchildren died of starvation and he\rhimself now lives a destitute life\ras a broken man.
translation_zh: 本星區曾有一商人，\r靠賣影音娛樂給智慧\r生物致富，眾人敬愛。\r後一日海盜來抄錄其\r貨並免費散布全銀河。\r因此盜行，商人妻兒\r餓死，他自己今貧苦\r潦倒，為一破碎之人。

original_en: Dangerous for your kind, is this \rplace. Last long will you not. \rPowerful ships you need, but slow \rthey will become. He he he he...
translation_zh: 對你族危險，此地。\r久留你不能。強大艦\r你需要，但慢將為。\r呵呵呵呵……

original_en: Arcturas III is trapped in the \rdarker ages of fear and ignorance.\rWhen you come across the four rows\rof chests, open three lids in the \rfirst row, three in the second\rrow, all lids in the third row,\rand the prize in the last row will\rbe yours.
translation_zh: 大角三號困於恐懼無\r知的黑暗時代。遇四\r排寶箱時，第一排開\r三蓋，第二排開三蓋，\r第三排全開，末排之\r賞便歸你。

original_en: I have been patrolling this sector\rfor a long time. There is little \rthat remains hidden from me. Mizar\r5 may be of particular interest to\ryou. There are two prizes to be \rfound there - the Cevitic Balancer\rand a Hataphas gem.
translation_zh: 我在此星區巡邏甚久。\r對我而言鮮有隱藏之\r物。米薩五號或許特\r別合你意。那兒有兩\r樣寶物：賽維提平衡\r器與哈塔法寶石。

original_en: The only way to enter the main\rcomplex on Ascella II is to use\ran Escape Code.  Be warned, if you\rdare to go there, buy life\rinsurance and lots of it.
translation_zh: 進入阿瑟拉二號主綜\r合區唯一方式是用脫\r逃碼。警告：若敢去，\r買壽險，買多點。

original_en: Be wary on Izar 2. Truth, there,\ris of vital importance, for no one\rknows the plans of the Concierge. \rUse the Star Stones of Arcturas\rIII to travel past the pockmarked\rwall.  Remember, always answer\rtruthfully what you are asked.
translation_zh: 在伊薩二號當心。在\r那兒真相至關重要，\r因無人知守門人之計。\r用大角三號的星石越\r過麻臉牆。記住，被\r問時必誠實回答。

original_en: There are radioactive piles on\rIzar 2 that could prove very\rhazardous to beings such as\ryourselves. They can be safely\rcleared away by using a Pickor.
translation_zh: 伊薩二號上有放射性\r堆，對如你這般生物\r極危險。用皮可可安\r全清除。

original_en: New growth takes place on \rVindemiatrix 1. The Concierge is \rfully behind it, though none can \rfathom his reasons for it. It is \rrumored that there once was a\rdirect teletrans between the new\rcolony and Izar 2. That's a far\rpiece of space to jump across.
translation_zh: 芬德米一號正展開新\r發展。守門人全力支\r持，但無人能參透其\r理由。傳聞新殖民地\r與伊薩二號間曾有直\r通跳躍傳送。那可是\r段不近的太空跳距。

original_en: The key to the most powerful\rweapon in the universe can be\rfound in this sector. Watch\ryourself if you use it, it packs\rquite a punch and kicks like a\rmule.
translation_zh: 宇宙最強武器之鑰可\r在本星區尋得。用時\r小心，威力不小，後\r座如騾踢。

original_en: Don't anger the Concierge, he is\rvery powerful and VERY dangerous\rwhen angered!
translation_zh: 別惹怒守門人，他極\r強且發怒時非常危險！

original_en: If you find yourself on Alnasl 1, \rthe Ominar will undoubtedly try to\renlist your aid. Be careful that\ryou use the proper Strandware on\rthe correct Ominar. And you may\rneed to visit Cor-Caroli 1 to find\rthe Microtic Injector needed to \radminister the Strandware.
translation_zh: 若你身處阿納斯爾一\r號，歐米納人必會試\r著請你協助。當心用\r對的鏈件給對的歐米\r納人。或許你還得訪\r科爾卡羅利一號取得\r注入鏈件所需的微注\r射器。

original_en: The Ominar are very intelligent \rcreatures. Many of their control \rmechanisms are difficult to \runderstand. These two things are \rknown to be used on Vega 9: NaCl, \rwhat you call salt, and H2So4,\rwhich you have a most peculiar\rname for. They will grant you\raccess to many things, as will a\rcertain key on Alnasl 1.
translation_zh: 歐米納人是極聰穎的\r生物。其控制機制多\r難以理解。已知在織\r女九號用此二物：氯\r化鈉，即你們所稱的\r鹽，及硫酸，你們對\r它有奇特名稱。它們\r將為你開啟諸多通道，\r阿納斯爾一號上某把\r鑰匙亦然。

original_en: Heed this warning, humans. Do not \rattempt to infiltrate Ascella 2.\rIf you do go there, you will need\rto have the most advanced weapons \ravailable, but even then your \rchances of survival are too low to\rcalculate. Knowing the escape \rsequence may be your only hope.
translation_zh: 人類，聽此警告。勿\r試圖滲透阿瑟拉二號。\r若你前往，須備最先\r進武器，即便如此存\r活率亦低不可計。知\r悉脫逃序列或為你唯\r一希望。

original_en: You must possess the most powerful\rweapons to survive in this sector.\rEven then your lives are worth\rvery little. Don't even think of \rexploring these planets without\rmega war abilities.
translation_zh: 要在本星區生存須持\r最強武器。即便如此\r命也值不了多少。沒\r頂級戰能別想探索這\r些星。

original_en: Primitive weapons work best\ragainst the Ominar. Keep low tech\rlevel items in your packs when\rdescending on Ascella 2.
translation_zh: 原始武器對歐米納人\r最有效。降落阿瑟拉\r二號時包裡備些低階\r科技品。

original_en: I speak Human goodly. My nose is \rshaky but my hair stops cars. Do\ryou have a social consideration?\rMy Chihuahua is inside-out, I must\rsay.
translation_zh: 我說人話棒棒。鼻顫\r但髮可擋車。可有社\r交關照？吉娃娃是裡\r外翻的，我必說。

original_en: You are very close to completing\rthe construction of your "Cygnus\rCanon." There is but one component\rmissing, and you will find it\rhere.
translation_zh: 你很接近完成你的\r「天鵝座炮」之建造。\r僅缺一件，可在此尋\r得。

original_en: Do you really think it's a good\ridea to use the Cygnus Canon? This\rtechnology is new to you. Have you\rforgotten what happened when smart\rcreatures tried to use it? Why\rdon't you just find a nice planet \rsomewhere safe and take it over\rfor yourselves. Cut your losses.
translation_zh: 你真覺得用天鵝座炮\r是好主意？此科技對\r你還新。忘了智慧生\r物試用時的下場嗎？\r何不找個安全的好星\r球占為己有，止損吧。

original_en: Mason Polk here, Moonbase commander. There\ris some concern about hostile aliens\rduplicating the Ulysses Exploration Team\rwith the intent of infiltrating the \rdatabanks of Moonbase and sabotaging\rinformation critical to the construction of\rthe Centauri Device. Please confirm your\ridentity by referring to your U.N.F.A. \rmanual and typing in the [ word on page\r|.]
translation_zh: 我是月球基地指揮官梅森．波\r克。有跡象顯示敵對外星人複\r製尤利西斯探索隊，意圖滲透\r月球基地資料庫並破壞半人馬\r裝置建造之關鍵情報。請參閱\r您的聯合星際艦隊手冊並輸入\r第 | 頁的 [ 字以確認身分。

original_en: The Calypso class starcruiser detailed in\rthese tech plans is a drastic improvement\rover our own Ulysses class exploration\rvessel.  An improvement on the power\refficiency curve allows for greater armament\rand more engine mountings. Moonbase\rEngineers tell me we will be able to mount\rfive weapons and five engine pods on the\rhull. You should notice a definite increase\rin speed.
translation_zh: 技術圖中詳述的卡呂普索級星\r艦巡航艦對我方尤利西斯級探\r索船是巨大提升。動力效率曲\r線改進，可配備更多武裝與引\r擎掛點。月球基地工程師告訴\r我，艦體可掛五件武器與五具\r引擎艙。速度應有明顯提升。

original_en: The information in these ship plans offers\ran improvement on the Calypso class\rstarcruiser, doubling the number of weapons\rmounts possible. The increased hull size\rallows for two additional engine pods and\rgreater cargo storage. I personally named\rthis hull type the Sheroshu, and if I hear\rone more person say 'gesundheit' I'll kick\rthem out of U.N.F.A. myself.
translation_zh: 這些艦圖資訊改進了卡呂普索\r級巡航艦，使武器掛點數加倍。\r艦體增大可多掛兩具引擎艙與\r更多貨倉。我親自將此艦型命\r名為謝洛舒，若再聽到誰說\r「祝你健康」我就親手把他踢\r出聯合星際艦隊。

original_en: Like the Sheroshu class, these starcruiser\rtech readouts allow for ten weapon mountings\rand seven engine pods. However, the great\rbulk of the hull design may cut back a\rlittle on the speed of the ship, depending\ron how you decide to equip her. The\rengineers decided to name this hull design\rthe Kerouac. Don't ask me what it's supposed\rto mean, you know how it is when tech people\rtry to be creative.
translation_zh: 如謝洛舒級，這些巡航艦技術\r讀數允許十處武器掛點與七具\r引擎艙。然而艦體龐大可能稍\r減速度，端看你如何配備。工\r程師決定將此艦型命名為克魯\r亞克。別問我這啥意思，你也\r知道技術人員耍創意是什麼樣\r子。

original_en: After carefully studying the tech plans and\rreferring to the data retrieved from the\rETS, Moonbase Engineers have determined that\rthe present number of armament and engine\rpods cannot be exceeded. It appears the\radvances in design detailed in these plans\rinvolve increased storage capacity and \rgreater shield protection. I worked with the\rengineers this time and we decided to name\rthis hull Harbinger.
translation_zh: 細究技術圖並參酌自 ETS 取\r回的資料後，月球基地工程師\r判定武裝與引擎艙數量無法再\r增。這些圖紙中的設計進步似\r為增大貨倉與強化護盾防護。\r這次我與工程師合作，決定將\r此艦型命名為先驅。

original_en: The hull type specified in these tech plans\rshould further increase your storage\rcapacity. Moonbase Engineers have overcome\rsome problems with the alien technology and\rI believe your shield protection can be\rboosted as well.  She may be a little slow,\rbut this ship should hold her own out there.\rThe boys in the communications center have \rnicknamed this design the Tempest.
translation_zh: 這些技術圖所指定的艦型應能\r再提升你的貨倉容量。月球基\r地工程師已克服外星科技的些\r許問題，我相信護盾防護也能\r隨之強化。她或許略慢，但這\r艦在外頭應能撐住自己。通訊\r中心那群人將此設計暱稱為暴\r風雨。

original_en: Moonbase Engineers wanted to call this ship\rdesign the space slug. That may give you an\ridea of what to expect in the way of speed\rand maneuverability. But she's a sturdy\rship, and you can arm her to the teeth. This\ris the boat I'd want to take into an all-out\rbattle. Lots of shields, lots of fire. Who\rneeds to move fast when you're blowing the\renemy away? I call her Fury.
translation_zh: 月球基地工程師原想稱此艦型\r為太空蛞蝓。這應能讓你大致\r了解其速度與機動性。但她是\r艘耐操之艦，可武裝到牙齒。\r這是我想帶上全面決戰的艦。\r護盾多，火力猛。把敵人轟飛\r時誰還需要快？我叫她憤怒。

original_en: Hello, team. As you may already suspect,\ryour genetic predecessors have died in the\rline of duty.  Fortunately the\rreconnaissance teams that we sent out were\rable to recover everything that the previous\rContact team gathered.  You may note slight\rdifferences in your abilities, but you are,\rafter all clones. We cannot caution you\renough that although you may have William,\rNelson, Osai and Katya's memories, you are\rin many ways different people.  Please be\rcareful in the future.
translation_zh: 各位你好。或許你們已猜到，\r你們的基因前身已於任務中殉\r職。所幸我方派出的偵察隊取\r回前接觸隊收集的一切。你們\r或察覺能力略有差異，但畢竟\r是複製體。雖然你們有威廉、\r尼爾森、奧賽與卡蒂亞的記憶，\r在許多方面你們是不同的人。\r今後請務必當心。
